context.transcript:
Hi, Javid.
I wanted to talk to you about our advertising strategy.
I was looking at the sales figures from the past few months.
We had a very significant drop in the amount of inventory our shoe store sold during the month we changed locations.
It was well under the 3,000 pairs we had.
It was well under the 3,000 pairs we expected.
And what's worse, the situation hasn't improved since then.
I think we need to spread our advertisements out more to make sure customers know about our new location.
Do we have enough money in the budget to put more ads in other local newspapers?
Let me know.
Thanks.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Javid。
我想和你谈谈我们的广告策略。
我看了过去几个月的销售数据。
在我们更换地点的那个月，我们鞋店的库存销量出现了非常显著的下降。
它远低于我们拥有的3,000双。
它远低于我们预期的3,000双。
更糟糕的是，从那时起情况一直没有改善。
我想我们需要更分散地投放广告，以确保顾客知道我们的新位置。
我们的预算里有足够的钱在其他本地报纸上刊登更多广告吗？
让我知道。
谢谢。
